name: Kami-sama no Iu toori Kujibiki Ai-biki Scramble
original_name: 神様のいうとおりッ　くじびきAI-BIKIスクランブル
source:
There is a weird class at our school where people from first to third grade are gathered for some purpose. I never expected to have anything to do with it, but here I am, a new class member surrounded by seven girls. As it turns out, there is a mysterious social study lesson where relationships are determined with a lottery. The theme of first lesson is "slave".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
我们学校有一个奇怪的班级，一年级到三年级的学生为了某种目的聚集在一起。我从没想过会与此有任何关系，但我在这里，一个被七个女孩包围的新班员。原来，有一堂神秘的社会学习课，人际关系是通过抽奖决定的。第一课的主题是“奴隶”。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
